name: stockhuntr
description: Remote MCP server for querying AI-analyzed SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), company snapshots, fundamentals-based stock screening, 30-day prediction signals, and the model's track record. All data is read-only and grounded in primary-source SEC EDGAR filings.

tools.name: get_latest_filings
tools.description: Recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings with AI analysis and 30-day predictions.

tools.name: get_filing_analysis
tools.description: Full AI analysis for a single filing by accession number.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company snapshot: sector, fundamentals, recent filings.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find tracked companies by ticker or name.

tools.name: screen_companies
tools.description: Filter 800+ companies by sector, market cap, P/E, dividend yield, and revenue growth.

tools.name: get_model_track_record
tools.description: Model accuracy from strict walk-forward backtesting plus live outcome counts.

disclaimer: StockHuntr is an educational/research tool. Predictions are model outputs, not investment advice.
